name: Ceeta Industries Ltd.
about: Ceeta Industries Ltd. manufactures and sells packaged food products in India. The company operates through two segments, Packaged Food Products and Other Operations. The Packaged Food Products segment engages in the manufacturing and job work of different varieties and flavors of ready to eat snacks under the Skitos brand, as well as offers fruit drink. The Other Operations segment is involved in trading transactions, including brokerage, transportation, interest income on short-term lending, and miscellaneous services. It also engages in financing and investment activities. Ceeta Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
